generate_2dgrid: generate a 2D coordinate grid tensor for a given height and width with optional centering
str2bool: convert a string like 'yes', 'true', or '1' into a Python boolean value
resize_pil: resize a numpy array image to a thumbnail of the specified size using PIL
find_map_size: calculate the map size in meters from height and width rounded up to the nearest ten
gettimestr: get the current UTC time formatted as a string like 2025-01-15--14_30_00
